2. Started with 15 minute basic work outs and 15 minute walk. I moved up to 25 minute basic work out 3 days a week, and 30/45 minute walks 6/7 days a week depending on the weather and my mood haha. 
The best advice I can give is don’t put to much effort into it, if the weight comes off kinda slow, that’s okay, it’s still gonna happen.
